podcast.body: This original blues song by Memphis Minnie gained significant recognition when it was adapted by Led Zeppelin in 1971. Her version featured her characteristic loud singing and hard guitar playing. She is credited as a songwriter on the Led Zeppelin recording, ensuring her estate received financial compensation from its success. "If it keeps on raining, laver's going to break."
